checks: Model acceptance binds the concrete independent full-model report and terminal owner, configuration, source hashes, all model bytes, and complete variable/row counts. It does not reinterpret the historical preliminary-owner inventory entry as the terminal owner hash.
The native parameter schema, Python wrapper and native helper hashes are pinned. Explicit parameters round-trip exactly, with one worker, fixed seed, 180-second native allowance and no repeated call.
The 300-second owner permits the native call only when at least 180 seconds plus the 60-second finalization reserve remain after complete model/parameter transport.
All primary and additional native vectors are saved before text parsing or exact checking. Parsed native vectors must equal these saved vectors.
Every returned vector is checked with exact Python integer arithmetic against all variable-domain intervals and all 168050 unconditional linear-row domains. Complete row activities are retained.

Each nonempty returned vector requires a separate independent query cold. Native INFEASIBLE remains unproved; UNKNOWN, budget overrun, malformed vectors and model errors are not upgraded to graph or component conclusions.

The separate query cold must require child returncode zero as well as report acceptance and complete bound artifacts. The outer owner does not itself separately test returncode in its report_accepted branch; the accepted preflight receipt has returncode zero.
